latHint: Think riding a bicycle - not an organ.
pivHint: An organist works a PEDAL with the feet - but to PEDAL down a road means to do what on a bike?
winText: Wheels turning. PEDAL was the pivot - an organ foot-key to a rider who will CYCLE.
lossText: CYCLE - to ride a bicycle. PEDAL was the pivot: organ PEDAL to PEDALing a bike.
